simulation_year: Non-leap synthetic year with 365 days and 8760 hourly intervals

household_load_design.interpretation: Synthetic hourly household demand for method development; not measured customer data.

battery_operation_plan.state_link: ending SOC of one day becomes the next day's initial SOC
battery_operation_plan.annual_terminal_target: final annual SOC returned near initial SOC

important_boundaries: All demand, solar, and price values are synthetic.
The model is an energy-management model, not a power-flow model.
Hourly grid import is an hourly-average power quantity.
Battery degradation will be evaluated after annual dispatch is validated.
No claim of empirical household savings is supported yet.
